dct_creator_sm: City of Milwaukee Department of City Development
dct_description_sm: This tabular dataset contains 138 City of Milwaukee properties with unpaid property taxes that the City has chosen not to foreclose upon because initial screening indicates potential environmental contamination, as of September 18, 2026. Fields include tax key, address, zoning, aldermanic district, assessed values, building and lot sizes, and current and past uses. Taxkey can be used to join the records to the City of Milwaukee Parcel Polygons and Master Property File datasets. The source portal states that the dataset is updated quarterly or as needed.
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
